features: Versioned task-scoped records with source task, trace, role, provider, model, stage, and evidence references
Changed content is flagged needs_review on old and new versions rather than silently replacing it
Foreign key prevents orphan task memory
Deletion requires explicit owner action and is scoped to one task
24,000 characters per record and 64,000 characters total per task
limitations: Not yet integrated with persistent task API database or Command Center
LL09 runtime restart and LL10 approval remain pending
